description: Controlled California pilot batch for scripts/collect-pilot.mjs. Exactly 5 targets — do not add or remove entries without updating docs/PILOT_RUNBOOK.md.
naming_rule: <state-code>-<county-slug>-<city-slug>-<utility-slug>.json, lowercase kebab-case, no underscores. See data/schema.json record_id pattern and docs/DATA_ARCHITECTURE.md Section 2.
utility_verification_note: Optional 'utility_verification' block per target records prior research on whether the named utility actually serves the named city, per scripts/collect-pilot.mjs's target-validity guard. Absent, or status 'confirmed', means collection proceeds normally. status 'contradicted' means collect-pilot.mjs refuses to collect for this target and returns CONFIG_ERROR with the evidence — see docs/PILOT_RUNBOOK.md.
